disconnectInstructions: disconnect_dl3: DL3 from CCU before first Ω step
disconnect_ds2: DS2 from CCU before door switch checkpoint
harness_test_prep: DL3 and DS2 unplugged at CCU and at lock assembly
analysis.laterTestEstablishesPathFault: Partially — harness_bad implies wire fault, but test is isolated pin-pin continuity, not through_path with load present
analysis.rationale: No at-load component_verified pass precedes CCU Ω; first measurements are at DL3 with CCU end only disconnected (harness still carries lock). Isolated harness continuity explicitly requires both ends open — not Gate 4 loadInCircuit=true. harness_bad confirms door_lock while OEM directs replace harness. Three sub-circuits (lock/unlock solenoids, DS2) plus live CCU output test exceed single anchor + path_open pair.
analysis.designGap: Wire-continuity checkpoint assertion (harness isolated), multi-subcircuit anchor policy, and CCU-first vs load-first sequencing — not new assertion types but compound conclusion rules.
analysis.futureMigrationNotes: Remain legacy; do not map harness_bad to path_open without new semantics.

analysis.laterTestEstablishesPathFault: j2_bad implies harness between RFI and ACU, but domain is AC voltage supply chain not Ω load
analysis.oemOutcomeAgreesWithSemantics: Mixed — j2_bad OEM is harness repair; line_out_bad is RFI replacement; all confirm supply
analysis.rationale: Procedure is supply segmentation (cord → RFI → J2 → ACU), not component-at-load then through_path Ω. No measurementContext or single anchored load. j2_bad could be read as path fault or supply segment failure; confirm_supply_critical_supply_fault collapses distinct OEM paths.
competingInterpretations: j2_bad as external_path_fault on supply vs supply segment confirm
Whether IF-connected J2 measurement implies loadInCircuit for any scoped Ω model (N/A — voltage steps)
missingEvidence: No at-load resistance verification of any replaceable load
No explicit through_path / loadInCircuit for voltage checkpoints

disconnectInstructions: disconnect_vch7: VCH7 from CCU only before CCU Ω
analysis.laterTestEstablishesPathFault: Yes for OL at VCH7 with good at component — structurally parallel to heater witness per coil
analysis.rationale: Two independent coil paths on one VCH7 connector share one componentId; single valve_comp_pass verifies both coils in one step. CCU open branches route to replace_valve (component) not harness/path OEM. Cold and hot CCU steps each re-eliminate inlet_valve on pass. Gate 4 pair rule applies per coil but compound run needs multiple pathRefs or split procedures.
analysis.designGap: Multi-pathRef / multi-coil compound conclusion on one componentId; optional per-coil component_verified scope; path-first terminal outcome missing for CCU-only open.
analysis.futureMigrationNotes: Per-coil migration (cold then hot) possible after compound policy; not safe as single naive seed pass.

analysis.designGap: Stateful switch pass/fail (OL expected), separate float_switch anchor, control-only P6 measurements.
analysis.futureMigrationNotes: Fix component attribution and float semantics before any scoped migration.
